% The portability workflow's live-host fixture (plain TeX, the pdftex
% format), compiled through flashtex-host's socket: once by the resident
% engine with restricted \write18, once as an export (a child engine, full
% \write18). host.sh checks the logs and env.txt.
%
% A \write18 and a pipe, both through the shell (cmd.exe on Windows). The
% pipe's command is in single quotes, which only Windows accepts
% (texmfmp.c's runpopen turns them into double quotes there; elsewhere they
% are a quotation error and the pipe stays closed).
\immediate\write18{kpsewhich --version}
\openin1=|"kpsewhich 'plain.tex'"
\ifeof1 \message{[pipe: closed]}\else
  \read1 to\found \closein1
  \message{[pipe: \found]}\fi
% Whether a \write18 child inherits FLASHTEX_INVOKED_AS, the variable that
% makes an engine child of the host run as pdftex on Windows (it must
% not). Only with full shell escape; restricted, the log says it was not
% run.
\immediate\write18{if defined FLASHTEX_INVOKED_AS (echo inherited> env.txt) else (echo clean> env.txt)}
Hello from flashtex-host.
\bye
